blind.description: A stylized stone statue of a cloaked, hooded figure (such as a wizard or monk) whose face is hidden in deep shadow. The figure holds a tall faceted staff resting on the ground with its right hand. It stands atop a circular stone pedestal featuring a mossy, gear-like toothed ring around the upper tier. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and clean with stylized hand-painted textures in weathered tan stone, earthy moss greens, and shadowed crevices. Underside sits flat on the floor with no floating elements or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: A circular cog or gear with radiating teeth enclosing a stone platform, displaying the top of the hooded head, shoulders, draped robe folds, and the faceted cap of the staff.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: circular stone plinth with a gear-toothed rim
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure); base is about 2.5 ft in diameter.
